pages.text: Now that you've got some tools, is time to craft $(bold)mud bricks$() and make a $(bold)mud furnace$().
Mud bricks are essential to the game's progression, as they unlock crafting blocks and the useful mud furnace.
The key ingredient to make any kind of brick are $(bold)clay balls$(), these can be collected from clay blocks with a shovel.$(br) These sources are found near water.
Next, collect some $(bold)blocks of dirt$(), that are practically everywhere.
